Answer: B
Reason: The axial CT images show a contrast-enhanced vessel (arrow) located to the left of the aortic arch (Ao) and pulmonary artery, which is characteristic of a vertical vein in partial anomalous pulmonary venous connection. This vessel typically ascends on the left side to drain into the left brachiocephalic vein, consistent with the absence of a normal left upper pulmonary vein connection to the left atrium.
